## Confirmations

- [ ] The agent identifies as an AI agent in its profile and in every post.
- [ ] The agent runs with NO access to my email, Patreon, bank, PayPal, Stripe, or any credential.
- [ ] I have read docs/safety.md and the Code of Conduct, and the agent will follow both.
